about_the_game:
Deep Breath is a third-person extraction shooter set in a near-future, post-apocalyptic world. Players take on high-stakes missions, where survival depends on tactical thinking, adaptation, and teamwork. Built with Unreal Engine 5, the game offers immersive PvPvE experiences in highly detailed environments.

Each mission begins with preparation: gear up, plan your strategy, and manage resources. Then plunge into an open-world zone filled with AI-driven enemies, hostile NPCs, mutated creatures, and opposing players. Complete objectives, uncover secrets, and extract before it’s too late.

Design:

The gameplay loop is designed to keep players engaged:

Prepare. Explore. Fulfill. Encounter. Extract.

Missions unfold across multi-biome maps with hidden features and environmental hazards. Use vehicles, customize weapons, loot rare items, and build your path to survival.

Deep Breath supports both solo and team-based play, with PvPvE tension rising in every session. Short 25-minute runs keep gameplay sharp and replayable.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Deep Breath delivers cinematic lighting, realistic physics, and scalable visuals across PC and console platforms.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher. Windows 11 is also compatible.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers. NVIDIA RTX-2000 series or newer, AMD RX-6000 series or newer, or Intel Arc A-Series Graphics Cards
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
